title: tc-budget-guard
description:
Spend and token limits for a live run: progress against the cap, a warning near it, a hard stop at it, and raising
the cap from the warning.

limits.description: The limits – the first one is the big meter. Raises apply unless a tc-limits-change listener calls preventDefault()

status.description: The run: "running", "paused" or "done" – always set by the app

heading.description: The heading, and the region's name

task.description: What runs, a quiet line under the heading

warnAt.description: Share of a cap from which the card warns (0–1)

currency.description: Currency of "currency" limits, an ISO 4217 code

cap.description: The hard limit: the run stops when `used` reaches it

kind.description: How the numbers read: money in `currency`, tokens (182.4k), or plain numbers with `unit`

rate.description: How much the run uses per minute right now – shown as the pace to the cap

raiseBy.description: Amounts the warning offers to add to the cap – defaults to half, all and twice the cap, rounded
